Leo: Quick ask  AE needs an invoice today for Aurora Tech's 45-day Dedicated pilot. They're asking for 22% off list. PO will arrive but procurement insists on invoice (no credits). Approve?
Jasmine: Numbers pls. 22% is just over our standard pilot band. Any signal they'll convert?
Leo: List = $27k/mo. At 22% off = $21,060/mo -> $31,590 total for 45 days. AE says product team is running an internal eval and conversion is likely if latency targets met. No commit in PO.
Ravi: Deal-desk rule: discounts >20% need RevOps + CFO signoff. Also request we tag invoice with "pilot_aurora" for reporting.
Ana: Legal: if Finance okays, add SOW addendum: pilot limited to 45 days, conversion requires separate agreement, and include limited liability + data usage clause.
BillingBot: draft invoice INV-2026-0711 created for $21,060/mo. Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0711
Jasmine: Margin check: 22% reduces headroom; need a usage cap or auto-reprice beyond 140k tokens/day. Can AE get that into the PO?
Leo: I'll push for the cap in a PO amendment. Customer procurement prefers plain invoice but might accept a short clause.
CFO_Sam: Conditional approve: I can sign off up to 20% automatically. For 22% we need RevOps brief + Exec exception. Send me ACV/ARR uplift case and regional priority; include the PO and SOW language.
Ravi: I'll prepare the billing tag and set a monthly reconciliation alert once invoice is sent.
Leo: Will escalate to RevOps now and attach conversion thesis. Will update thread when PO amendment arrives. :thumbsup:
